title: Auth Service Latency Degradation post v3.2.0
symptoms: JWT token validation latency increased from 5ms to 450ms
evidence: Redis monitor log showed 88% miss on auth:token:* keys
root_cause: Key prefix mismatch in v3.2.0 cache key generator caused 88% cache miss rate.
resolution: Patched cache key generator in v3.2.1 and warmed token cache.
